text:
maria: heads-up — planning to merge a small TF module refactor now. I hoisted provider blocks to root to avoid duplicate provider versions across modules, pinned providers, and regenerated the .terraform.lock.hcl. please give a quick sanity check on secrets wiring; I moved the k8s secret resource out of module 'db' into the cluster-level module.

ken: :eyes: what versions did you pin?

maria: aws = "~> 4.60.0" and kubernetes = "~> 2.16.0". lockfile updated in the branch.

sam: can you paste the plan diff for the secret move so I can confirm no recreate?

maria: sure, plan excerpt below (it's a move):
```diff
- module.db.kubernetes_secret.db_creds[0]
+ module.cluster.kubernetes_secret.db_creds[0]
```

lee: will that change affect Helm releases that reference the secret by module-scoped name? we usually lookup by name in values.yaml.

maria: I kept the actual metadata.name the same via a local, so Helm sees the same name. example: 
```hcl
locals { db_secret_name = "db-prod-creds" }
resource "kubernetes_secret" "db_creds" {
  metadata { name = local.db_secret_name }
  data = { ... }
}
```

ken: ok good. did you add a state mv step? we need to run `terraform state mv` during rollout or the plan will try to recreate. also add a CI preflight that runs `terraform plan -target=module.cluster.kubernetes_secret`.

maria: added a `scripts/state-move.sh` and a CI job `preflight:secret-move` in the PR. ran the move locally against staging state — plan shows no recreates.

ops-bot: canary plan for branch `maria/hoist-providers-pin` passed — 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy :white_check_mark:

sam: LGTM from me. one tiny nit: please add a short note in CHANGELOG.md explaining the provider pin (compat with eks module upgrade).

maria: will add the changelog note and squash the small commits. merging after one more thumbs-up. @ken @lee any last blockers?

ken: none from infra side. :thumbsup:

lee: same, looks safe to me. :shipit:

maria: merging in 10m unless someone flags something.
